Title: Welcome to your ultrafast home
Use: Openreach ONT indicator meanings: solid-green PON with LOS off is normal; PON off or flashing green, or red LOS, may indicate a network issue.
Limitations: Openreach full-fibre homeowner leaflet; only the stated PON/LOS patterns are supported.

Title: What do the lights on the Openreach modem mean?
Use: Openreach ONT PON/LOS meanings: PON flashing with LOS off is verification; PON off or PON and LOS both flashing may indicate a fibre-link problem. BT lists Huawei, ECI and Nokia indicator layouts and states that all Ethernet Port lights off means the cable to the Hub may be missing or broken; check both ends or try a new cable.
Limitations: Applies to Openreach modem variants; power, PON, LOS, Optical and LAN/Port layouts vary by model. The current questionnaire does not interpret ECI Optical states or other unlisted patterns, which remain unknown.

Title: I have problems connecting 5GHz and dual band devices wirelessly to the BT Hub

Limitations: BT Hub-specific consumer guidance; does not establish the cause of the separate Plusnet Hub One case
